status: frozen after one semantic-correction baseline and before the comparative grid
holdout_policy: No outcome or trajectory at or after holdout_start may be read until one final candidate is frozen.
motivation: The official ReadMe defines PipeLow and PipeGrow as raw process temperatures, distinct from *_min_sp/vip setpoints. Replaying them exposed that AGC pipe geometry is unavailable and the inherited GreenLight lPipe is an analogue assumption.

grid.interpretation: cDgh is the total screened-vent discharge coefficient; lPipe is an effective rail-pipe exchange length, not a claim about unreported installed geometry.

selection_objective.primary: minimize the maximum RMSE divided by its frozen gate across tAir, rhIn, and co2InPpm for pooled data and every compartment
selection_objective.tie_breaker: minimize the mean pooled normalized RMSE across the three channels

full_calibration_check: Run exactly one selected candidate on all 21 continuous calibration sequences and require the frozen gate pooled and for every compartment before holdout access.
claim_boundary: Observed-pipe replay is valid only for historical trajectory validation. A separate actuator model is required for counterfactual heating control.
